{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|If you can use your best efforts to vote an amendment onto the upcoming military appropriations bill, you'll find us extremely appreciative.|Lando Calrissian to Fyg Boras|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>}}
The '''New Republic military appropriations bill''' was an act passed by the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] sometime in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], having being put forward by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Senate Defense Council/Legends|Defense Council]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way" />

==Contents==
One of its resolutions was that the New Republic would purchase more than a thousand [[YVH 1]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] from [[Tendrando Arms]], a company owned by former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[General/Legends|general]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way" />
